description: A library and command line program for working with Fountain script/screenplay formatted files.
name: fountain
releaseNotes: Boneyards (/* ... */, one line or several) are parsed as Boneyard elements, where a one-line boneyard used to read as Action and the lines of a multi-line one as Character, Dialogue and Action. Scene headings carry their number (INT. KITCHEN - DAY #12A#) in the new Element.SceneNumber, and the JSON output has scene_number. New BoneyardText returns the text between the delimiters. Added for the knowledge module's story support.
